name: file-helpers
description: Safe file I/O and JSON storage utilities: readOrFallback, writeSafe, appendSafe, deleteFileSafe, fileExistsSafe, toJsonSafe, fromJsonSafe, readJsonObject, readJsonObjectSafe, and writeJsonObject.

operations.name: fileExistsSafe
operations.description: Checks whether a file exists safely on the filesystem.

operations.name: readOrFallback
operations.description: Safely reads file content as text, or returns fallbackValue if file does not exist or read fails.

operations.name: writeSafe
operations.description: Safely writes text content to filePath, returning true on success or false on failure.

operations.name: appendSafe
operations.description: Safely appends text content to filePath, returning true on success or false on failure.

operations.name: deleteFileSafe
operations.description: Safely deletes a file if it exists, returning true on success or false on failure.

operations.name: toJsonSafe
operations.description: Converts an object or thing to JSON text, returning fallbackValue on serialization error.

operations.name: fromJsonSafe
operations.description: Parses a JSON string into a thing object, returning fallbackValue on deserialization error.

operations.name: readJsonObject
operations.description: Reads a JSON file from disk into a thing object, returning gone if the file does not exist or fails to parse.

operations.name: readJsonObjectSafe
operations.description: Reads a JSON file from disk into a thing object, returning fallbackValue if the file does not exist or fails to parse.

operations.name: writeJsonObject
operations.description: Serializes an object or thing to JSON and writes it to filePath on disk, returning true on success or false on failure.
